description: This Java source file defines the utility class HiveFunctionRegistryUtils, which provides methods for reflection-based method lookup, invocation, and argument type matching for Hive UDFs and UDAFs, based on Hive 2.3.10. It is used to avoid initializing Hive built-in UDFs by programmatically selecting and invoking methods.

classes.name: HiveFunctionRegistryUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing reflection-based method lookup, invocation, and argument type matching for Hive UDFs and UDAFs, based on Hive 2.3.10.

methods.name: getMethodInternal
methods.description: Retrieves a method from a class matching the specified name and argument types, considering exactness and method overloading.

methods.name: getMethodInternal
methods.description: Selects the closest matching method from a list of methods based on argument types and conversion costs.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method reflectively, handling exceptions and providing detailed error messages.

methods.name: matchCost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of converting one argument type to another, returning -1 if incompatible.

methods.name: filterMethodsByTypeAffinity
methods.description: Filters candidate methods to select the one with the closest argument type affinity based on primitive grouping.
